title: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 5 to Be Your New ‘Everyday’ Assistant
summary: Anthropic has released a new Claude model , Opus 5, bringing it close to the capabilities of Claude Fable 5 at half the price. Anthropic says Opus 5’s strengths lie in knowledge work, autonomy and biology.
